'''Dana Drábová''' (3 June 1961 – 6 October 2025) was a [[Czechs|Czech]] physicist and politician. She was the chair of the State Office for Nuclear Safety from 1999 to 2025, and served as President of the 2023 meetings of the parties to the [[Convention on Nuclear Safety]].

==Life and career==
Drábová was born in [[Prague]] on 3 June 1961.<ref name="seznambio">{{cite web |title=Dana Drábová |url=https://www.seznamzpravy.cz/tag/dana-drabova-12121 |website=Seznam Zprávy |access-date=7 October 2025|language=cs}}</ref> She went to school in [[Říčany]], before studying at the [[Czech Technical University in Prague]]. She studied at their [[Faculty of Nuclear Sciences and Physical Engineering CTU in Prague|Faculty of Nuclear and Physical Engineering]],<ref name="seznambio" /> specialising in [[dosimetry]] and the application of radiation. She gained the "[[Engineer's degree#Czech Republic, Poland and Slovakia|Ing.]]" degree after she completed her thesis on the ''Measurement of neutrons and determining the dose from neutrons using microdosimetry''.<ref>{{Cite web |title=Ing. Dana Drábová, Ph.D., Dr. h. c. mult.|url=https://www.ceskatelevize.cz/lide/dana-drabova/ |access-date=20 March 2023 |publisher=[[Czech Television]]|language=cs}}</ref>

She was the chairwoman of the {{ill|State Office for Nuclear Safety|cs|Státní úřad pro jadernou bezpečnost}}.<ref name=fule/>

In 2013 Drábová (popularly known as "The Atomic Crone", a nickname she sometimes jokingly used herself) was awarded an honorary degree from the [[Technical University of Liberec]] for her work in popularizing science. She has appeared on television programmes and she was an advocate for technical science to high schools and university students. Drábová has given lectures at the Liberec university.<ref>{{Cite web |last=Trdla|first=Martin|date=30 October 2013 |title=Jaderná lady Drábová dostala v Liberci čestný doktorát za propagaci vědy |url=https://www.idnes.cz/liberec/zpravy/dana-drabova-dostala-cestny-doktorat.A131030_160152_liberec-zpravy_tm |access-date=20 March 2023 |website=[[iDNES.cz]]|language=cs|publisher=[[Mafra (company)|Mafra]]}}</ref>

The businessman [[Michal Horáček]] stood to be President of the Czech Republic. He announced his advisers in February 2017, including former Slovak presidential candidate [[Magdaléna Vášáryová]], Dana Drábová, and surgeon [[Pavel Pafko]].<ref>{{Cite web |date=9 February 2017 |title=Kandidát na prezidenta Horáček představil tým dvanácti poradců. Jsou v něm Drábová, Vášáryová i cyklista König |url=https://domaci.hn.cz/c1-65618620-kandidat-na-prezidenta-horacek-predstavil-tym-dvanacti-poradcu-jsou-v-nem-drabova-vasaryova-i-cyklista-konig |access-date=20 March 2023 |website=[[Hospodářské noviny]]|language=cs|publisher=[[Economia]]|agency=[[Czech News Agency]]}}</ref>

In 2018 she was on the board of the think tank [[Institute of Modern Politics iSTAR]].<ref>{{Cite press release |date=20 February 2019 |title=Think tank hnutí Starostové a nezávislí je na světě |url=https://ekolist.cz/cz/zpravodajstvi/tiskove-zpravy/think-tank-hnuti-starostove-a-nezavisli-je-na-svete |access-date=20 March 2023 |website=Ekolist.cz |language=cs}}</ref>

In 2023 she announced that the six Czech nuclear reactor units would be looking for an alternative supplier for its nuclear fuel.<ref name=fule>{{Cite web |title=Dukovany NPP to change fuel suppliers|url=https://www.neimagazine.com/news/newsdukovany-npp-to-change-fuel-suppliers-9696032 |access-date=20 March 2023 |website=Nuclear Engineering International}}</ref>

She was President of the 8th and 9th joint meetings of the parties to the [[Convention on Nuclear Safety]] in March 2023.

Drábová died after a serious illness on 6 October 2025, at the age of 64.<ref>{{cite news |last=Ferenčík|first=Jakub|title=Dana Drábová passes away at 64 |url=https://english.radio.cz/dana-drabova-passes-away-64-8864997 |access-date=6 October 2025 |publisher=[[Czech Radio]]|date=6 October 2025}}</ref><ref>{{cite news |last1=Schalek|first1=David|last2=Beneda|first2=Josef|title=Ve věku 64 let zemřela Dana Drábová. Přes čtvrt století vedla Státní úřad pro jadernou bezpečnost|url=https://www.irozhlas.cz/zpravy-domov/ve-veku-64-let-zemrela-dana-drabova-zastaval-pozici-predsedkyne-statniho-uradu_2510061809_job|access-date=6 October 2025 |publisher=[[Czech Radio]]|date=6 October 2025|language=cs|agency=[[Czech News Agency]]}}</ref>
